thesis_summary.why_market_wrong: FY2025 was an exceptional volume year (+58.9% turnover) ahead of Greece's FTSE Russell upgrade from Advanced Emerging Market to **Developed Market** status effective **21 September 2026**. **[Inference]** Screens and passive models may still treat ATHEX as a small emerging-market venue, while filings show developed-market preparation and Euronext integration already priced into activity. **[Inference]** The market may also capitalize FY2025 peak cash flows; our base case normalizes owner cash below the FY2025 spot of **€0.87** per share from operating activities minus capital spending. **Predictive attribute:** FTSE developed-market reclassification (dated Sept 2026) plus Euronext liquidity cross-listing synergy; partially offset because Euronext already controls the float.
